releaseNotes:
1. Admin Hub Layout Fix: Resolved activeCount reference error when opening Catalogue.
2. Streamlined Printer Setup: Retained direct installed printer driver selector; removed redundant layout parameters.
3. Header Minimalist Peripherals: Top header now displays exclusively the Digital Scale live weight stream.
4. Cloudflare CDN Stale-Cache Prevention: Instant delivery of new packages without edge caching.
5. Automated In-App Detached Update Relaunch: Seamlessly replaces files and restarts Plannest POS without white screen hangs.
